description: Generate a single optimized Boolean search query for Google Patents from a natural-language description of an invention or technology. Returns one Boolean string only. Use `search` for a multi-strategy set of queries (broad/moderate/narrow) instead. Costs 1 credit.

description.description: Natural-language description of the invention or technology area (e.g. 'foldable smartphone display with ultrasonic fingerprint sensor'). Minimum 10 characters.

name: query

optimizedQuery.description: The generated Boolean search query for Google Patents.
